nicholas: Heads-up: us-west3 has a weird oscillation — tiny GPU jobs (0.125) get scheduled, attach succeeds but within ~20s they get evicted for "node-local quota exceeded". Happens mostly on nodes labeled `gpu.redwood/tiny-accept=true`.
anya: I think I've seen this before. Could be our allocator accounting mixing fractional requests with historic reservations; if a node had a big-gang reservation mark, we subtract reserved slots but rounding bug could undercount and then trigger later.
ben: Pulled attach + kubelet logs from gpu-node-21: 
ben: ```
May 12 11:02:14 kubelet[1]: attach-plugin: attach succeeded for pod tiny-xg-11 -> device: 0
May 12 11:02:34 kubelet[1]: eviction-controller: evicting pod tiny-xg-11 namespace=training reason="node-local quota exceeded"
May 12 11:02:34 allocator[svc]: quota_check: available_slots=1 reserved_biggang=0.875 requested=0.125 -> pass
May 12 11:02:34 allocator[svc]: reconcile: recomputing allocations -> rounding leftover -0.999 -> mark node_overcommitted=true
```
ben: That rounding leftover of -0.999 looks bogus. Shouldn't happen.
anya: Rounding bug came from the new fractional allocator where we multiply by 1000 to avoid float drift, but forgot to floor when computing leftover after subtracting reservations. Edge case: reserved_biggang expressed as 7/8 (0.875) -> internal integer math gives remainder -999.
nicholas: So post-schedule the reconciler flips node to overcommitted and eviction controller kicks in. Oof.
ops-runner: For mitigation I can cordon the worst nodes and drain tiny pods onto nodes with full tiny capacity. Running: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-21 && kubectl drain gpu-node-21 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
ops-runner: cordon/drain in progress.
ben: I'm pushing a hotfix to allocator: use integer math with explicit floor at the end and clamp to [0,slots]. Adding fuzz tests covering fractions like 0.125,0.25,0.333.
anya: Also let's add a reconciler safety window: if reconcile detects leftover magnitude >0.5*slot_unit, don't mark overcommitted, instead emit alert and pause auto-eviction for 60s. Reduce churn.
infra-bot: deploy job started: allocator/fraction-fix #342 -> canary (us-west3)
nicholas: Good. Also flagging cost impact: we've seen ~0.9 GPU-hours wasted due to attach/evict retries in last 3hrs. Finance wants a short blurb for chargeback.
ben: Canary looks stable: no spurious negative leftovers for new allocations. Rolling to prod in 5m.
ops-runner: Drain complete; pods rescheduled and healthy on alternate nodes. Some training jobs lagged but recovered.
anya: Postmortem actions: 1) fix integer math and add fuzz tests (ben), 2) add reconciler safety window + alert (anya), 3) ops runbook: cordon/drain playbook for overcommit flips (ops-runner), 4) telemetry: metric `allocator.leftover_fraction` and alert >0.4 (nicholas).
ben: PR: https://git.redwood/scheduler/pull/342 - includes tests and doc note.
infra-bot: deploy job succeeded: allocator/fraction-fix #342 -> prod (us-west3)
nicholas: Thanks. Keeping watch for residual evictions; will open postmortem doc later today. :thumbsup:
